items.headline: Upsets and chaos reign supreme in college football's Week 8
items.description: With more top-ranked teams losing, college football continues to be unpredictable in 2026.

items.headline: Week 8 live: Best moments and top plays
items.description: Top moments and what we're seeing from around college football.

items.headline: Josh Hoover, Indiana get first win at Michigan since 1967
items.description: Josh Hoover had a 4-yard TD run in overtime and No. 6 Indiana kept Michigan out of the end zone in a 13-6 win -- the Hoosiers' first at the Big House since 1967.

items.headline: Hoover's TD run lifts No. 6 Indiana to 13-6 OT win at Michigan, its 1st win at Big House since 1967
items.description: — Josh Hoover is banged up and was almost benched because of his injuries.

items.headline: CJ Carr watches brother Tommy's first Michigan start from Big House
items.description: Week 8 is Notre Dame's bye week, meaning Tommy Carr had a special spectator in attendance for his first start: his brother CJ.

items.headline: Michigan QB Tommy Carr, grandson of ex-coach, gets first start
items.description: Michigan freshman quarterback Tommy Carr made his first start Saturday against No. 6 Indiana.
